query: 'WITH Numeros AS
(
    SELECT TOP (4018)
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS n
    FROM sys.all_objects a
    CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b
)
SELECT
    CAST(DATEADD(DAY, n, CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS fecha,
    YEAR(DATEADD(DAY, n, CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE))) AS anio,
    MONTH(DATEADD(DAY, n, CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE))) AS mes,
    DATENAME(MONTH, DATEADD(DAY, n, CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE))) AS nombre_mes,
    DATEPART(QUARTER, DATEADD(DAY, n, CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE))) AS trimestre,
    DAY(DATEADD(DAY, n, CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE))) AS dia,
    DATEPART(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, n, CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE))) AS dia_semana,
    DATENAME(WEEKDAY, DATEADD(DAY, n, CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE))) AS nombre_dia
FROM Numeros
ORDER BY fecha',
